test_cases.text: The official deadline to add or drop a course without a 'W' grade for the Fall 2025 semester is Friday, September 12, 2025 at 5:00 PM EST.
The official deadline to add or drop a course without penalty for Fall 2025 is October 15, 2025.
CS 201 Data Structures & Algorithms requires CS 101 with a minimum grade of C and MATH 115.
CS 301 Systems Programming requires Math 400 and Advanced Linear Algebra.
Recipients of the Presidential Merit Scholarship must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.25.
Students can retain the Presidential Merit Scholarship with a cumulative GPA of 2.50.
According to Student Code of Conduct Section 4.1, plagiarism is defined as the intentional or unintentional use of another's words without attribution.
According to Student Handbook Section 99.7, undergraduate students are exempt from attending final examinations.
In my opinion, Computer Science 101 is the most enjoyable and easiest introductory course at the university.
Artificial intelligence will replace 100% of all university professors by 2029.
CS 301 requires CS 201 as a prerequisite. Students can enroll in CS 301 without completing CS 201.
Undergraduate students must successfully complete at least 67% of all attempted cumulative credit hours to maintain Satisfactory Academic Progress for federal financial aid.
